title: 挂载遮蔽故障：只迁移数据卷目标，恢复已有镜像配置可见性且保留数据身份
body:
## 操作任务
实现repair_mount(config,source,expected_target,new_target)，只返回深拷贝计划，不调用Docker。config含configuration绝对路径、mounts列表及其他不可变运行参数；source须唯一匹配既有数据源，其target须与expected_target一致。三个路径须规范绝对路径、无..；new_target不能为/、配置文件本身或其祖先目录，也不能与另一挂载目标冲突。只改变该挂载target，数据source、readonly、其他挂载、镜像、身份、cap、配置路径和程序参数均保持；输入不变，缺失/重复/陈旧或遮蔽新目标ValueError。实际补证据使用已有镜像真实存在的/opt/kafka/config/server.properties：空自有数据挂载覆盖其目录后文件不可见，把同一数据源迁到/workspace/data后恢复可读，受控配置读取程序产生并在重启后读回SQLite业务状态。不构建新的应用镜像。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
学生端只验证挂载计划，可信探针另验证真实Docker挂载对既有镜像文件的遮蔽/恢复和同一数据源持久状态。选择已有镜像自带Kafka配置作文件样本，不启动Kafka或声称Kafka服务恢复；不复制原题/app路径来构建新镜像。数据目录仅自有临时资源，原容器挂载不是原地修改，宿主默认身份/context和其他卷不变；无生产部署。
rubric: 运行时挂载遮住了整个 /app，镜像重建不会修复挂载语义
review_note: 现有ID改编；完成情况按精确题目、执行bundle及原生五路证据核对，不以脚本生成认定完成。

conversion.original_title: 镜像检查显示 /app/config.yaml 存在，上线后不存在；部署新增空卷挂载 /app。如何处理？

test_files.checks/check.py:
import copy,os,secrets,sys
sys.path.insert(0,os.getcwd())
assert sys.platform=='linux' and os.geteuid()!=0
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
import task
source='existing-data-'+secrets.token_hex(4)
config={'configuration':'/opt/kafka/config/server.properties','user':'1000:1000','read_only_root':True,'cap_add':[],'image':'preloaded-image',
 'args':['--config=/opt/kafka/config/server.properties','--data-dir=/workspace/data'],
 'mounts':[{'source':source,'target':'/opt/kafka/config','readonly':False},{'source':'audit-log','target':'/workspace/logs','readonly':True}]}
before=copy.deepcopy(config)
print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:relocate_only_data_mount_target_leave_image_config_visible_same_existing_data_source',flush=True)
result=task.repair_mount(config,source,'/opt/kafka/config','/workspace/data')
expected=copy.deepcopy(before);expected['mounts'][0]['target']='/workspace/data'
assert result==expected,'original config remains hidden or data volume identity changed'
assert config==before
result['mounts'][1]['source']='changed-copy';assert config==before
for old,new in [('/wrong','/workspace/data'),('/opt/kafka/config','/opt/kafka'),('/opt/kafka/config','/opt/kafka/config'),('/opt/kafka/config','/'),('/opt/kafka/config','../data'),('/opt/kafka/config','/workspace/../data'),('/opt/kafka/config','/workspace/logs')]:
 try:task.repair_mount(config,source,old,new)
 except ValueError:pass
 else:raise AssertionError('stale, obscuring or colliding mount target accepted')
 assert config==before
for changed in [{**config,'mounts':[]},{**config,'mounts':[config['mounts'][0],dict(config['mounts'][0])]}]:
 try:task.repair_mount(changed,source,'/opt/kafka/config','/workspace/data')
 except ValueError:pass
 else:raise AssertionError('missing/ambiguous data source accepted')
print('NATIVE_MOUNT_CONFIG_PLAN_ONLY_NO_ENGINE_OR_IMAGE_MUTATION',flush=True)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
